decisions.reason: F17 and step 2.2 incorrectly made the untruncated chain distance a global metric. For S={s,t}, m(s,t)=infinity, X has two isolated vertices and no chain between them. Supplier (iii) gives compact geodesic component metrics only; truncation gives distance pi across components. The Statement already uses that valid truncated metric, and step 5.1 already uses intrinsic component metrics, so the conclusion survives. Corrected F17 and step 2.2. Also qualified the coset-indexed faces in F4 and step 1.1 as nonempty, matching the current supplier; no empty face is used in the link calculation.

F1 omits the supplier clause (3) condition that a common fixed set be nonempty before it is declared contractible. Translation x->x+1 on the complete proper CAT(0) real line has empty fixed set, which has no point to contract to. Restored the condition in F1 and the owning page summary. Step 1.1 already proves nonemptiness using the finite nonempty orbit center before invoking fixed-set geometry; hence the theorem Statement and its proof conclusions are valid without alteration.

The owning page now states contractibility only for nonempty common fixed sets, and the contract boundary evidence records this hypothesis.
